key_components.login_page: Halaman Login dengan latar foto instansi, form username/password, dan tombol langsung ke Public Jadwal & Display Board
key_components.dashboard_table: Tabel Jadwal Rapat max 40 data, pencarian real-time, filter tanggal & ruangan, badge warning 'Surat Belum Diunggah', cetak PDF/Excel, tombol share link modal
key_components.input_modal: Form Input/Edit Jadwal lengkap (Tanggal, Ruangan, Jam Mulai-Selesai, Unit Kerja, Kegiatan, Alat Zoom toggle, Susunan Kursi khusus Ruhui Rahayu, Nama/No WA, Petugas Pencatat, Upload File Surat PDF/Image)
key_components.flight_board_display: Tampilan Papan Bandara TV Dinding (gelap, font monospace besar, status 4 warna, marquee footer text, waktu live WIB, auto reload countdown)
key_components.weekly_calendar: Kalender Mingguan interaktif untuk Halaman Jadwal Public & Dashboard
key_components.settings_page: Pengaturan Running Text Footer Display, Kelola 15 Ruangan, Kelola Petugas Pencatat, Simulasi Upload Logo & Latar Login

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_rules: All interactive inputs, buttons, tables, filters, modals, and status badges MUST include data-testid (e.g. data-testid="schedule-input-room-select", data-testid="flight-board-status-badge").
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: APCA & WCAG AA compliant. Hover states must explicitly set hover:text-white or hover:text-slate-900 to ensure full legibility.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard React .js file conventions (JSX syntax in .js files).
Ensure layout uses full width container up to 1800px as specified by user choices.
Support both Light and Dark mode using Tailwind class-based dark mode toggle.
Implement Web / Mobile version toggle in top navigation bar for responsive preview.
Ensure Conflict Detection logic alerts user when booking overlapping times for the same room.
Ensure PDF and Excel exports allow column selection before downloading/printing.
Display page must look like a high-tech Airport Flight Information Display System (FIDS) for government hall TVs.
